logline: Told their chance of a child is under one percent, a young Ethiopian couple wait nine years and cross a border to become a family.
audience: Draft, to be confirmed by the applicant: families and couples in Ethiopia and the diaspora who are waiting for something they have been told is unlikely
intent: Feel that a small chance is still a chance, and want to keep trying
style_block: Hand-painted gouache illustration, visible brush texture, soft film grain, warm amber and terracotta palette with deep indigo shadows, gentle firelight, quiet and intimate, subject centred in frame, full-bleed painting reaching every edge

people.statement: Based on the applicant's own family story. Faces are invented drawings made from text and the narrator is a stock synthetic voice. Nobody's photograph or recording is used. Consent is recorded in ETHICS.md.

am.style: warm, calm and unhurried, like telling a family story at night

en.style: warm, calm and unhurried, like telling a family story at night

mother.prompt: Character portrait of an invented young Ethiopian woman in her twenties, oval face, warm brown skin, dark hair parted in the centre and drawn back under a thin white cotton netela shawl with a narrow green and gold woven border, long white handwoven cotton dress, small plain round silver stud earrings, hopeful calm expression, facing the viewer, plain warm background, upper body

father.prompt: Character portrait of an invented young Ethiopian man in his late twenties, slim face, warm brown skin, short dark hair, trimmed short beard, white handwoven cotton collared shirt, kind steady expression, facing the viewer, plain warm background, upper body

coffee_set.prompt: Still life of a traditional Ethiopian coffee set on a low dark wooden tray. A matte black clay jebena: a wide round ball-shaped belly, a narrow straight neck, a thin short pouring spout rising from the shoulder, a curved clay loop handle from neck to belly, a small straw lid on the neck. Beside it small white porcelain handleless cups with a thin green rim. Plain wooden floor, soft warm side light

video.negative_prompt: text, letters, subtitles, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, morphing, flicker, fast motion, camera shake, blurry, low quality

music.caption: Instrumental, intimate Ethiopian highland mood, solo krar lyre plucked gently, soft washint flute answering far away, warm low drone, sparse and tender, pentatonic, acoustic, close room sound, no drums, no vocals

cues.note: A few plucked notes under the number
The opening notes return, then fade on the end card

shots.reason: Opens on the number and an empty place, before we know whose it is
shots.image_prompt: An empty small handwoven Ethiopian straw baby basket lined with a folded white cotton blanket, on a wooden floor beside a window, pale dawn light falling on it, dust in the light
shots.motion_prompt: The curtain sways in a soft breeze, dust drifts through the light, the camera pushes in very slowly

narration.am: እኔ ከመወለዴ በፊት አንድ ቁጥር ነበር፤ አንድ በመቶ።
narration.en: Before I was born, there was a number. One percent.

shots.reason: Meets the parents young and certain, so the waiting costs something
shots.image_prompt: the same mother from the reference and the same father from the reference as young newlyweds standing side by side in white handwoven cotton clothes with green and gold borders, shoulders touching, smiling at each other, warm afternoon garden behind
shots.motion_prompt: The couple turn toward each other and smile, she laughs softly, their clothes move in a light wind, the camera is fixed

narration.am: እናቴና አባቴ በወጣትነታቸው ተጋቡ፤ ልጅ እንደሚወልዱም እርግጠኛ ነበሩ።
narration.en: My mother and father married young, sure that a family would follow.

shots.reason: The two cups make the waiting visible; this object returns at the end
shots.image_prompt: Low dark wooden tray holding one round black clay jebena and exactly two small white cups with a thin green rim, side by side, wide empty space around them, quiet room, light fading at the window
shots.motion_prompt: Steam curls up from the two cups, the window light slowly dims, the camera slides gently sideways

narration.am: አንድ ዓመት። ሁለት። አምስት። በእያንዳንዱ ቡና፣ ያው ሁለት ሲኒ።
narration.en: One year passed. Then two. Then five. Every coffee ceremony, the same two cups.

shots.reason: Their waiting is active: prayer, patience and trying again
shots.image_prompt: the same mother from the reference seated by candlelight at night, white shawl over her hair, eyes closed, hands pressed together near her chest, quiet prayer, dark room
shots.motion_prompt: Her lips move silently in prayer, she breathes slowly, the candle flame flickers, the camera is fixed

narration.en: They prayed. They waited. They tried again.

shots.reason: The bad news, held on the couple rather than the doctor
shots.image_prompt: the same mother from the reference and the same father from the reference seated close together in a plain consulting room, holding hands tightly, heads lowered, cool daylight from a high window
shots.motion_prompt: Her shoulders rise and fall with a heavy breath, he slowly squeezes her hand and turns his head to her, the camera is fixed

narration.am: ከዚያ ሐኪሙ እውነቱን ነገራቸው፦ በኢትዮጵያ ዕድላቸው ከአንድ በመቶ በታች ነበር።
narration.en: Then a doctor told them the truth. Here in Ethiopia, their chance was less than one percent.

shots.reason: The turn: the parents choose a question over an ending
shots.image_prompt: the same mother from the reference lifting her face with a determined look toward the same father from the reference beside her, warm lamp light on both faces, night window behind
shots.motion_prompt: She raises her head and speaks, her lips moving, he looks at her and nods slowly, the camera pushes in gently

narration.am: ብዙ ሰው እዚህ ያቆም ነበር። ወላጆቼ ግን ጠየቁ፦ ሌላ የት እንሞክር?
narration.en: Most people would have stopped there. My parents asked a different question: where else can we try?

shots.reason: Distance made visible: far from home, the same two people
shots.image_prompt: the same mother from the reference and the same father from the reference seen from behind, walking hand in hand along a sunlit pale stone hillside street with olive trees, one small suitcase, morning light ahead of them
shots.motion_prompt: They walk slowly forward, her shawl and the olive leaves move in the wind, the camera follows gently behind

narration.am: መልሱ ሩቅ ነበር፤ እስራኤል። አዲስ ሐኪሞች፣ አዲስ ቋንቋ፣ ለዓመታት ያው ተስፋ።
narration.en: The answer was far from home. Israel. New doctors. A new language. The same hope they had carried for years.

shots.reason: The arrival, in a hand rather than a face; a breath before the peak
shots.image_prompt: Extreme close view of a newborn baby hand with tiny fingers wrapped around one adult finger, white blanket, soft golden morning light
shots.motion_prompt: The tiny fingers slowly open and close around the finger, the blanket moves with breathing, the camera is fixed

shots.reason: The emotional peak: the line she still says, on her face
shots.image_prompt: the same mother from the reference, older now with a few silver hairs, face filling the frame, joyful eyes, mouth open speaking warmly toward the viewer, golden window light
shots.motion_prompt: She speaks warmly, her lips and jaw moving naturally, then breaks into a smile and blinks, the camera is fixed

narration.am: እናቴ ዛሬም ትላለች፦ «ሌሎች ሴቶች በዘጠኝ ወር ይወልዳሉ፤ እኔ ግን በዘጠኝ ዓመት ወለድኩ።»
narration.en: My mother still says: “Other women give birth in nine months. I gave birth in nine years.”

shots.reason: The tray fills: the two cups become five
shots.image_prompt: Low dark wooden tray holding one round black clay jebena and exactly five small white cups with a thin green rim in a neat row, bright warm morning room
shots.motion_prompt: Steam rises from the five cups, sunlight moves across the tray, the camera slides gently sideways

narration.am: ከዚያ ታናሽ እህቴ፣ ከዚያም ታናሽ ወንድሜ መጡ።
narration.en: Then came my little sister. Then my little brother.

shots.reason: The number becomes a family around the same tray
shots.image_prompt: the same mother from the reference and the same father from the reference, older, seated around a coffee tray with three invented children seen from behind, warm home, golden light
shots.motion_prompt: The family lean together and laugh, shoulders moving, a child reaches toward the tray, steam rises, the camera pulls back slowly

narration.am: ያ አንድ በመቶ እኔ ነበርኩ። ሁላችንም ነበርን።
narration.en: I was the one percent. We all were.

shots.reason: Returns to the opening basket in full light and turns to the viewer
shots.image_prompt: A small handwoven Ethiopian straw baby basket beside a bright open window, white cotton blanket folded inside with one small bright yellow flower resting on it, golden sunrise light flooding the room
shots.motion_prompt: The curtain lifts in the breeze, sunlight grows brighter across the basket, the camera pulls back slowly

narration.am: ዕድላችሁ አንድ በመቶ ነው ቢሏችሁ፣ አስታውሱ፦ አንድ በመቶ ዜሮ አይደለም። ተስፋ አትቁረጡ።
narration.en: So if anyone ever tells you your chance is one percent, remember: one percent is not zero. Never give up.

lines: Pictures, voice and music made with AI
A true family story. All faces are invented.
